<entry id="O00321">
<head-word>סוּלָּם</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown">סֻלָּם; סָלַל II)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>ascent, ladder</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. III, 6, v. מִצְרִי II. Gen. R. s. 68 בו עולים ויורדים בס' 
<italic>bo</italic> (Gen. XXVIII, 1</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>, that is, they went up and down the ladder. Ib. סֻלָּם זה סיני 
<italic>sullam</italic> (whose numerical value is 110) is Sinai; a. fr.—סוּלָּמָהּ של צור 
<italic>the Ladder of Tyre</italic> (Scala Tyriorum), a promontory south of Tyre.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ab. Zar. I, 40
<sup>a</sup> bot.; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. סוּלָּמוֹת</plural-form>. Gen. R. l. c. הקב"ה יושב ועושה ס' וכ' the Lord makes ladders, causing one to go down, the other to rise (on the social scale). Sabb. 26
<sup>a</sup> מס' של צור וכ' from the Promontory of Tyre (along the sea-coast) to Haifa. Ruth R. to IV, 21 (play on שַׂלְמוֹן) עד כאן עשו ס' לנשיאים וכ' thus far they made ladders for princes (the genealogical tree of chiefs), from now (Salmon) they made ladders for kings; a. fr.—2) 
<italic>a yoke</italic> in the shape of a ladder, put on the ass to prevent him from scratching a sore. Sabb. V, 4 (54
<sup>b</sup>), v. לוֹעָא.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> a sort of 
<italic>hem, chain-stitch</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. M. Kat. III, 83
<sup>d</sup>, v. קֶפֶשׂ.—
<italic>Pl.</italic> as ab. Bab. ib. 26
<sup>b</sup> הקורע … מתוך הס' he who rends his garment (in mourning) where it has been mended with chain-stitches after a previous rent.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup>).—Y. B. Kam. IV, 4
<sup>b</sup> לא מטון לס' דצור וכ' they (the Roman delegates) had not yet arrived at the promontory of Tyre (v. preced.), when they had forgotten everything. Bekh. 55

<entry id="O00332">
<head-word>סוּם</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="U00433">שׂוּם</xref>) 
<italic>to attach, place; to tie together</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tosef. Shebi. I, 11 אין סָמִין את הגפנים וכ' Var. ed. Zuck. (text: אף סימין; oth. ed. אין סכין) you must not bind the grape-vines in the Sabbatical year.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>סִיֵּים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same. Cant. R. to VII, 1 (ref. to same.</definition>
<notes> Cant. R. to VII, 1 (ref. to שולמית ib., a. Num. VI, 26) אומה שמְסַיְּימִים לה שלום וכ' a nation to which peace is assigned every day; (Gen. R. s. 66 שהכהנים מְשִׂימִין לה שלום וכ').</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to mark, name</italic> (cmp. שׁם, שׁוּם); 
<italic>to distinguish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah VII, beg. 20
<sup>a</sup> הדקל מְסַיְּימוֹ the neighboring palm-tree serves as a mark for it (that the owner did not forget it); זה מְסַיֵּים וכ' they mark each other (cmp. Mish. ib. 1 שיש לו שם). Deut. R. s. 7 סַיְּימֵנִי בתוך המדינה וכ' give me some distinction in the country, (by which to show) that I am thy son. Y. Ber. V, end, 9
<sup>d</sup> וסִיְּימוּ באותה וכ' and they noted (the time when he said it), at that very time he (the patient) asked for food. Y. Meg. I, 71
<sup>d</sup> וסיימו אותן חכמים וכ' the scholars noted them (took their names &c., in order to be able to observe their career), and all of them turned out great men; Gen. R. s. 1. Y. Dem. V, 24
<sup>c</sup> bot. ומְסַיֵּים … סִיַּימְתִּי and he makes a mark (on the pile), and says to the priest, so far I have marked (as tithe); a. fr.—[Gen. R. s. 42 end ומסיים את עצמך, v. סוּף II.]—Part. pass. מְסוּיָּים, מְסוּיָּם; f. מְסוּיֶּימֶת &c. Y. Peah l. c. היה מס' בדעתו if it (the olive or the sheaf left behind) was noted in his mind (so that he could identify it), כאילו הוא מס' it is to be considered as if it were marked (by a special name, locality &c.). B. Bath. 54
<sup>a</sup> שדה המס' במצריה a field definable by its boundaries. Y. Yeb. XV, 15
<sup>a</sup> אדם מס' a well-known man. Y. Shek. I, 46
<sup>b</sup> top דבר המס' an object which bears the name of its owner. Gen. R. s. 44 מה איים הללו מס' בים וכ' as the islands are distinguishable in the sea, so were Abraham and Shem distinguished in the world; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to tie up; to finish, wind up</italic>, opp. פתח.</definition>
<notes> Arakh. 10
<sup>b</sup> פתח בחליל ומסיים באבוב the Mishnah begins with 
<italic>ḥ</italic>
<italic>alil</italic> and ends with 
<italic>abbub!</italic> Ber. 10
<sup>a</sup> פתח בה באשרי וס' באשרי he began it (the psalm) with 
<italic>ashré</italic> and closed it with 
<italic>ashré</italic>; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab. Y. Bets. I, beg. 60
<sup>a</sup> בהמה יולדת לחדשים מס' every animal gives birth after a certain number of complete months, opp. למקוטעין counting a fraction of the last month as a whole month.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִסְתַּיֵּים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be marked, defined</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ter. III, 42
<sup>b</sup> top מקום שנִסְתַּיְּימָה וכ' where the T’rumah of one pile was marked, there (in the corresponding place) the T’rumah of the other pile was meant to be dedicated. Y. Shebi. VIII, 38
<sup>a</sup> זה שהוא … ונסתיימה לו וכ' if one used a basket for measuring and after using it two or three times knew exactly how much it contained; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be finished, concluded</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 125
<sup>b</sup> דבר זה נפתח בגדולים ונ' וכ' this subject was opened by great men and has been concluded by small men.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="O00333">
<head-word>סוּם</head-word>
<head-word>סִים</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. O. Lev. XIX, 14 תְסִים ed. Berl. (oth. ed. תְשֵׂים); a. e.—Part. סָאֵים, סָאֵם, סָיֵים, סָיֵם. Targ. Prov. VI, 27. Ib. XXVI, 24. Ib. XI, 15.—V. שׂוּם.—Gitt. 56

<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>סַיֵּים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> same, esp. same, esp. 
<italic>to put on shoes</italic> (cmp. Ez. XXIV, 17).</definition>
<notes> Gitt. l. c. בעא למְסַיְּימָא וכ' he wanted to put on the other shoe. Taan. 12
<sup>b</sup> דמסַיְּימֵי מסנייהו וכ' that they wear their shoes and come to the fast-meeting. Ib. כי מסיימי וכ', v. אַפַּנְתָּא; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to mark, define</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Sabb. VI, 8
<sup>c</sup> bot. סַיְּימוּן וכן וכ' they marked (the time), and so it was.—Part. pass. מְסַיַּים. B. Bath. 100
<sup>a</sup> דמְסיְּימָן מחיצתא when the partitions are distinctly defined; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to finish</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Gen. XLIV, 18 Tosefta (ed. מחסיל).—Meg. 25
<sup>a</sup> סַיַּימְתִּינְהוּ לשבחיה וכ' hast thou exhausted all the praises of the Lord? Ber. 12
<sup>a</sup> פתח … דשכרא וס' בדחמרא he began the benediction under the impression that it was beer, and closed with the benediction over wine. Ib. 17
<sup>a</sup> כי הוה מְסַיֵּים צלותיה וכ' when he closed his prayer, he said &c. B. Mets. 76
<sup>b</sup> סַיְּימוּהָ קמיה they cited it (the Boraitha) before him to the end; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab. Cant. R. to I, 11 מְסַיְּימָה, v. חֲתַם.—[Targ. Y. I Deut. VIII, 9 מסימין, v. חֲסַם.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִסְתַּיֵּים</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be marked, named</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. 16
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. מינאי ומינך תִּסְתַּיֵּים שמעתתא this tradition will be named from myself and from thee.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be concluded, proved</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 31
<sup>b</sup> תסתיים דר' וכ' it can be conclusively proved that it was R. … who said &c.; תסתיים it is proved.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<head-word>סוּמָא</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>blind, blind man.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ḥag. I, 1. Ib. 2
<sup>a</sup> ס' באחת מעיניו blind in one eye. Taan. 21
<sup>a</sup> ס' משתי עיניו blind in both eyes. Ex. R. s. 36 פקח וס' שהיו וכ' a seeing and a blind man that were walking &c. B. Bath. 12
<sup>b</sup>; Nidd. 20
<sup>b</sup> כס' בארובה, v. אֲרוּבָּה; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. סוּמִים, סוּמִין</plural-form>. Gen. R. s. 53 בשעה … הרבה ס' נתפתחו when Sarah was remembered, many childless women were remembered with her, … many blind persons had their eyes opened. Ib. (ref. to Gen.
